Архива: geometry | 8 одделение | 6/10 тежина

Текст на задачата

Задача:
In a rectangle ABCDABCDABCD with perimeter 606060 cm, BC=23ABBC = \frac{2}{3}ABBC=32​AB. On side ABABAB, a point EEE is given such that AE=13ABAE = \frac{1}{3}ABAE=31​AB, and on side BCBCBC, a point FFF is given such that BF=23BCBF = \frac{2}{3}BCBF=32​BC. If point GGG is the midpoint of segment ADADAD, what is the area of triangle EFGEFGEFG? ![Problem Visualization](media/geom_8_2018_rect.mp4) # Solution First, let's find the dimensions of the rectangle. Let AB=aAB = aAB=a and BC=bBC = bBC=b. We are given b=23ab = \frac{2}{3}ab=32​a. The perimeter is 2(a+b)=60  ⟹  a+b=302(a+b) = 60 \implies a+b = 302(a+b)=60⟹a+b=30. Substitute bbb: a+23a=30  ⟹  53a=30  ⟹  a=18a + \frac{2}{3}a = 30 \implies \frac{5}{3}a = 30 \implies a = 18a+32​a=30⟹35​a=30⟹a=18. Then b=23(18)=12b = \frac{2}{3}(18) = 12b=32​(18)=12. So AB=CD=18AB = CD = 18AB=CD=18 cm and BC=AD=12BC = AD = 12BC=AD=12 cm. The area of the rectangle is SABCD=18⋅12=216S_{ABCD} = 18 \cdot 12 = 216SABCD​=18⋅12=216 cm2^22. Now let's find the lengths of the segments: AE=13AB=13(18)=6AE = \frac{1}{3}AB = \frac{1}{3}(18) = 6AE=31​AB=31​(18)=6 cm. EB=AB−AE=18−6=12EB = AB - AE = 18 - 6 = 12EB=AB−AE=18−6=12 cm. BF=23BC=23(12)=8BF = \frac{2}{3}BC = \frac{2}{3}(12) = 8BF=32​BC=32​(12)=8 cm. FC=BC−BF=12−8=4FC = BC - BF = 12 - 8 = 4FC=BC−BF=12−8=4 cm. GGG is the midpoint of ADADAD, so AG=GD=12AD=12(12)=6AG = GD = \frac{1}{2}AD = \frac{1}{2}(12) = 6AG=GD=21​AD=21​(12)=6 cm. We calculate the area of △EFG\triangle EFG△EFG by subtracting the areas of the three corner shapes from the total area of the rectangle. 1. Area of △AGE\triangle AGE△AGE: △AGE\triangle AGE△AGE is a right-angled triangle at AAA. SAGE=12⋅AG⋅AE=12⋅6⋅6=18S_{AGE} = \frac{1}{2} \cdot AG \cdot AE = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 6 \cdot 6 = 18SAGE​=21​⋅AG⋅AE=21​⋅6⋅6=18 cm2^22. 2. Area of △EBF\triangle EBF△EBF: △EBF\triangle EBF△EBF is a right-angled triangle at BBB. SEBF=12⋅EB⋅BF=12⋅12⋅8=48S_{EBF} = \frac{1}{2} \cdot EB \cdot BF = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 12 \cdot 8 = 48SEBF​=21​⋅EB⋅BF=21​⋅12⋅8=48 cm2^22. 3. Area of trapezoid GDCFGDCFGDCF: GD∥FCGD \parallel FCGD∥FC (since AD∥BCAD \parallel BCAD∥BC). Height is DC=AB=18DC = AB = 18DC=AB=18 cm. SGDCF=GD+FC2⋅DC=6+42⋅18=102⋅18=5⋅18=90S_{GDCF} = \frac{GD + FC}{2} \cdot DC = \frac{6 + 4}{2} \cdot 18 = \frac{10}{2} \cdot 18 = 5 \cdot 18 = 90SGDCF​=2GD+FC​⋅DC=26+4​⋅18=210​⋅18=5⋅18=90 cm2^22. Total area to subtract: Ssub=18+48+90=156S_{sub} = 18 + 48 + 90 = 156Ssub​=18+48+90=156 cm2^22. Area of △EFG\triangle EFG△EFG: SEFG=SABCD−Ssub=216−156=60S_{EFG} = S_{ABCD} - S_{sub} = 216 - 156 = 60SEFG​=SABCD​−Ssub​=216−156=60 cm2^22. The area of triangle EFGEFGEFG is 606060 cm2^22. ![Rectangle Area](images/geom_8_2018_rect.png)

Решение

Решение:
1. **Одредување на страните на правоаголникот:** Периметарот е L=2(AB+BC)=60L = 2(AB + BC) = 60L=2(AB+BC)=60, па AB+BC=30AB + BC = 30AB+BC=30. Дадено е BC=23ABBC = \frac{2}{3}ABBC=32​AB. Заменуваме во равенката: AB+23AB=30AB + \frac{2}{3}AB = 30AB+32​AB=30 53AB=30  ⟹  AB=30⋅35=18 cm\frac{5}{3}AB = 30 \implies AB = 30 \cdot \frac{3}{5} = 18 \text{ cm}35​AB=30⟹AB=30⋅53​=18 cm BC=23⋅18=12 cmBC = \frac{2}{3} \cdot 18 = 12 \text{ cm}BC=32​⋅18=12 cm Плоштината на правоаголникот е PABCD=18⋅12=216 cm2P_{ABCD} = 18 \cdot 12 = 216 \text{ cm}^2PABCD​=18⋅12=216 cm2. 2. **Одредување на положбата на точките:** * AE=13AB=13⋅18=6AE = \frac{1}{3}AB = \frac{1}{3} \cdot 18 = 6AE=31​AB=31​⋅18=6. Тогаш EB=18−6=12EB = 18 - 6 = 12EB=18−6=12. * BF=23BC=23⋅12=8BF = \frac{2}{3}BC = \frac{2}{3} \cdot 12 = 8BF=32​BC=32​⋅12=8. Тогаш FC=12−8=4FC = 12 - 8 = 4FC=12−8=4. * GGG е средина на ADADAD, па AG=GD=12AD=12⋅12=6AG = GD = \frac{1}{2}AD = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 12 = 6AG=GD=21​AD=21​⋅12=6. 3. **Пресметка на плоштината на △EFG\triangle EFG△EFG:** Од плоштината на правоаголникот ги одземаме плоштините на фигурите во ќошевите: * △AGE\triangle AGE△AGE (правоаголен кај AAA): PAGE=12⋅AG⋅AE=12⋅6⋅6=18P_{AGE} = \frac{1}{2} \cdot AG \cdot AE = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 6 \cdot 6 = 18PAGE​=21​⋅AG⋅AE=21​⋅6⋅6=18 * △EBF\triangle EBF△EBF (правоаголен кај BBB): PEBF=12⋅EB⋅BF=12⋅12⋅8=48P_{EBF} = \frac{1}{2} \cdot EB \cdot BF = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 12 \cdot 8 = 48PEBF​=21​⋅EB⋅BF=21​⋅12⋅8=48 * Трапез GDCFGDCFGDCF (прав агол кај DDD и CCC, висина DCDCDC): Основи се GD=6GD=6GD=6 и FC=4FC=4FC=4. Висината е DC=AB=18DC=AB=18DC=AB=18. PGDCF=GD+FC2⋅DC=6+42⋅18=5⋅18=90P_{GDCF} = \frac{GD + FC}{2} \cdot DC = \frac{6 + 4}{2} \cdot 18 = 5 \cdot 18 = 90PGDCF​=2GD+FC​⋅DC=26+4​⋅18=5⋅18=90 Вкупната плоштина што се одзема е: Psub=18+48+90=156P_{sub} = 18 + 48 + 90 = 156Psub​=18+48+90=156 Плоштината на △EFG\triangle EFG△EFG е: PEFG=PABCD−Psub=216−156=60 cm2P_{EFG} = P_{ABCD} - P_{sub} = 216 - 156 = 60 \text{ cm}^2PEFG​=PABCD​−Psub​=216−156=60 cm2 Конечниот резултат е 60 cm260 \text{ cm}^260 cm2.
